Standards-based programming prevents arbitrary sizing; budget is a constraint applied after the program is developed, not a replacement for it. Collaborative spaces don't eliminate circulation needs; the standard already accounts for collaborative function within the SF per reader. NAA = (100 × 15 SF) + (10,000 × 0.1 SF) = 2,500 SF. Libraries require significant circulation, mechanical, and structural space. A 0.60–0.70 efficiency factor produces GBA of 3,571–4,167 SF.
